Final thoughts

What the rotation proved.

TraderSwift update1 min readRead Markdown ↗

A rotation is the hardest test for a key held in shares.

The easy way would have been to copy the shares onto new machines. The right way was to make a new key together, show it trading with real money, and only then take the old set away.

It also found a fault we wouldn't have seen otherwise. The checklist for the rotation on Fri 20 Nov 2026 closes it, and Policy v2 arrives with that rotation.
